note: Explorer Beta is a BETA stream: a heavily-managed, buy-only rule set that passed its own backtests but had no forward record when it launched. Every rule in it was chosen after seeing the last two years of results, several of them as risk preferences rather than measured edge, and its backtested return is concentrated in a handful of thin financial names. Its engine is frozen, so the record built here stays comparable with that backtest; treat the backtest figures as an upper bound until the record is large enough to compare.

candidates.measured: at or below the prior day
